notes.title: BloodPit: Skelton II arriving tomorrow
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41659014/079c7d49bad1fe01ee1caf4c3ecf22acd9a5a590.png[/img]Fight through the endless waves in the blood pits. Beneath the surface 'Skelton' zones. They use the magnets to pull travelers out of space-time travel. They want the human genes. They are relentless and have given up on the formal lives they once lived. They are merged between AI and people. They want abandonment of all things human, right and just. The travelers are locked away in the pits and the pits never end. You saw the surface fights in the uninhabitable 'Skelton' zones where no human can go, now you must fight again. Each floor is different. Each traveler is hidden. Each disgusting hostile can bleed. 

How many can you save? How may can you Kill?
